Meet Mo

Flute direction

Vertical flutes are required for standard wire H-stakes. Horizontal flutes are better for wooden stakes, zip-ties, fences, or poles.

Heads up — wire H-stakes need vertical flutes. We’ll run these vertical unless you tell us otherwise.

Tap or click to browse · PDF, PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, SVG, AI or EPS · We check raster images instantly against the 300 DPI print standard at your selected sign size. You can add more than one file.
How do you want to handle it?

We require print ready artwork.

Print-ready means 300 DPI at full size — your file sized exactly to your sign, at 100% scale. PDF, vector, or a high-resolution image all work. Don’t have artwork? If we design it for you, that’s an extra fee — new design work runs $95–$295 and artwork corrections $50–$75 per file. Or with our Design Online tool. Sending artwork later? Email it to info@signs2go.us so we can match it to your order.
